name: Hanba Gunji
source:
3rd year Western Cuisine student.
The reliable older brother of the boarding house.
The former captain of the baseball club.
His shoulders are really strong because of that experience so he can easily carry around heavy pots.
The big brother type who will happily take care of anybody who is having troubles.
